top_module.name: domino_active_aero_controller
top_module.description: Top-level ASIC wrapper integrating input preprocessing handshakes, model request/response orchestration, freshness supervision, deterministic actuator command synthesis, clamping, fallback arbitration, telemetry, and sticky fault reporting.
top_module.functionality: Coordinates the entire active-aerodynamics control transaction. It accepts preprocessed vehicle geometry and flow-condition descriptors using ready/valid handshakes, packages them into bounded-width model request payloads with monotonically increasing request_id and timestamp/cycle-age metadata, forwards requests to an external DoMINO runtime, accepts only matching responses, checks freshness and sequence ordering, synthesizes deterministic actuator commands from validated model outputs using fixed-point arithmetic and configuration gains/tables, clamps outputs to legal actuator limits, and arbitrates to a safe fallback command on reset, invalid input, stale or mismatched response, timeout, model unavailability, payload corruption, or internal fault. It also exposes telemetry and sticky faults.
responsibilities: Fan out clock and reset to all submodules.
Provide top-level request/response/actuator/fault interfaces.
Hold all outputs safe on reset and while configuration is incomplete.
Enforce request sequencing and freshness supervision.
Prevent any direct bypass from model response to actuator output.
Expose telemetry for request_id, response_match, freshness_ok, clamp_event, fallback_active, and source_select.
top_module.reset_behavior: On rst_n deassertion, all outputs are driven to safe values, outstanding request state is cleared, request_id resets to a known safe value, fallback_active asserts, actuator_cmd is driven to cfg_safe_actuator_cmd after clamping semantics, model request valid deasserts, model response ready asserts only as architecturally safe, and sticky faults are cleared only by defined clear mechanism.
behavior_rules: All sequential state is synchronous to clk.
No local physics or neural inference is performed.
Every issued request increments request_id monotonically.
Every request carries request_id and timestamp/cycle-age metadata.
Responses are accepted only when response IDs match the outstanding request ID and freshness/ordering checks pass.
Stale, duplicated, missing, mismatched, or corrupted responses suppress model-derived actuator commands and assert fault_valid with a stale-command or protocol fault code.
Command synthesis shall use deterministic fixed-point arithmetic only.
Actuator outputs shall always pass through the clamper before reaching the output port.
Fallback shall be prioritized on any fault, mismatch, stale condition, timeout, model unavailable condition, invalid input, reset, or configuration-not-ready condition.
Sticky fault state remains asserted until cleared by the defined clear mechanism.
source_select indicates whether the currently driven actuator_cmd originated from validated model output or fallback.

modules.name: request_orchestrator
modules.description: Deterministic request sequencing and ingress buffering for vehicle geometry and flow conditions. Builds model request payloads and manages request_id/timestamp generation, outstanding transaction tracking, and ready/valid decoupling.
modules.functionality: Accepts geometry and flow descriptors, packages a model request payload, increments request_id monotonically, assigns request timestamps/cycle-age, and holds request output valid until the external runtime accepts the transaction. It asserts a timeout event when the outstanding request exceeds the programmable watchdog threshold. It does not interpret the model payload beyond architecture-defined packing.
responsibilities: Sequence request issuance.
Preserve request/response transaction correlation fields.
Provide bounded transaction tracking.
Expose timeout_event for safety supervision.
modules.reset_behavior: Clears outstanding transaction state, deasserts request valid, resets request_id and timestamp counters to safe values, and drives ready outputs according to safe reset policy.
behavior_rules: Monotonically increment request_id for each new model transaction.
Carry request_id and timestamp in every request.
Accept geometry and flow only when both are valid and the controller is configured.
Do not generate or transform any physics-model inference data.
Timeout detection is synchronous and deterministic.
Request payload format is bounded-width and architecture-defined.

modules.name: domino_runtime_interface
modules.description: Protocol adapter between the controller and the external NVIDIA DoMINO Automotive Aero runtime. It forwards request fields, receives model response payloads, and performs request_id and freshness comparisons before declaring a response match.
modules.functionality: Implements the external runtime handshake, compares response request_id against the outstanding request_id, checks freshness/ordering constraints, and only qualifies payloads as valid when integrity and sequencing rules pass. It marshals request and response payloads without performing inference or local model synthesis.
responsibilities: Enforce request/response correlation.
Qualify valid responses only after ID and freshness checks.
Expose the validated payloads for downstream deterministic control synthesis.
Assert fault indication on stale, duplicated, mismatched, or corrupted responses.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, deassert response qualification, assert safe readiness policy, clear correlation state, and ensure no unvalidated payload is released downstream.
behavior_rules: Response match is asserted only when response request_id equals the outstanding request_id.
Freshness is rejected when the response exceeds the programmable freshness threshold or violates ordering rules.
Validated payload outputs must only reflect a qualified response.
No direct model-derived actuator path is permitted from this module.
Any stale or mismatched response triggers a fault qualifier.

modules.name: command_synthesis_engine
modules.description: Deterministic fixed-point engine that maps validated model outputs and configuration gains into an actuator command vector. It performs no direct passthrough from unvalidated model data.
modules.functionality: Uses synthesizable fixed-point arithmetic to transform qualified model outputs into a raw actuator command. The mapping may be feedforward or table-based and is parameterized by configuration gains or ROM contents. It does not expose unclamped output to the top level and never drives actuators directly.
responsibilities: Generate deterministic model-derived command candidates.
Preserve synthesis-friendly arithmetic.
Never use unqualified model data.
Provide a valid qualifier for downstream clamping and arbitration.
modules.reset_behavior: Resets raw command to a safe value and deasserts raw_cmd_valid.
behavior_rules: Use only deterministic fixed-point arithmetic.
Do not implement physics, inference, or stochastic behavior.
Do not directly drive actuator outputs.
Only produce raw commands when validated model data is present.
Parameterization shall be synthesis-time or register-configurable.

modules.name: actuator_clamper
modules.description: Saturating actuator limiter that enforces per-channel bounds on every actuator command and reports clamp events for telemetry and fault visibility.
modules.functionality: Applies deterministic saturating arithmetic to enforce minimum and maximum actuator limits. It must clamp every output channel to legal bounds and raise clamp_event whenever saturation occurs.
responsibilities: Enforce actuator min/max limits.
Generate telemetry-visible clamp_event.
Prevent unclamped values from escaping to the output interface.
modules.reset_behavior: Resets clamped command to safe zero/constant behavior and deasserts valid while clearing clamp_event.
behavior_rules: Saturate to the nearest legal bound on overflow or underflow.
Never expose the unclamped path externally.
Clamp_event must be visible to top-level telemetry and fault logic.
All arithmetic shall be synthesizable and deterministic.

modules.name: safe_fallback_manager
modules.description: Deterministic safe-state controller that produces a predefined safe aerodynamic configuration whenever reset, invalid input, stale response, timeout, model unavailable, payload corruption, internal fault, or configuration-not-ready conditions occur.
modules.functionality: Implements a synchronous fallback state machine that selects a predefined safe aerodynamic actuator command and holds it until health checks and valid configuration are present. It combines fault qualifiers and configuration readiness into a stable fallback_active indication.
responsibilities: Generate safe fallback actuator commands.
Hold safe outputs on reset and while configuration is incomplete.
Assert fallback_active whenever any fault or invalid condition is present.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, enters fallback mode, asserts fallback_active, and drives the safe configuration as the active command source until configuration and health conditions allow exit.
behavior_rules: Fallback must be deterministic and synthesis-friendly.
Safe configuration shall be a synthesis-time constant or configuration register value.
Fallback has priority over model-derived commands on any fault or invalid condition.
Fallback outputs still pass through the actuator clamper at the top level.

modules.name: safety_supervisor
modules.description: Final arbitration and sticky fault aggregation block that selects between clamped model-derived commands and clamped fallback commands, prioritizing fallback on any fault, mismatch, stale condition, timeout, or configuration not ready condition.
modules.functionality: Arbitrates the final actuator command between model-derived clamped commands and fallback commands. It prioritizes fallback on any fault or invalidity, maintains sticky fault latching until cleared by the defined mechanism, and emits the final actuator command/valid outputs to the top level.
responsibilities: Select the only legal output source.
Prioritize fallback over model-derived control.
Generate sticky fault reporting.
Provide source_select telemetry indicating model or fallback origin.
modules.reset_behavior: Resets arbitration to fallback, asserts safe outputs, clears non-sticky state, and initializes sticky fault latch according to safe reset policy.
behavior_rules: No direct model-to-actuator bypass is permitted.
Fallback is prioritized on any fault, mismatch, stale condition, timeout, or configuration-not-ready condition.
Only one source may drive the final actuator_cmd at a time.
Sticky faults remain asserted until the clear mechanism is applied.
source_select must indicate whether the output is from model-derived or fallback command source.
